ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of B3-3 Community Shopping District
symbols as shown on Map No. 2-I

in the area bounded by:
A line 75 feet south of and parallel to Congress Street; California Avenue; A line 100
feet south of and parallel to Congress Street; the public alley next West of and parallel

to California Avenue.

To those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 508 S. California Avenue
